name: Feral Scar Vale
summary: In western Feralas, Feral Scar yetis hold a rocky gorge deep in the High Wilderness. Their caves lie beyond the forest trails, where travelers face danger.

sections.title: Lair of the Yetis
sections.body: For generations the primal Feral Scar yetis have held the caves of Feral Scar Vale. Unlike the yetis of Alterac and Dun Morogh, these brutes have adapted to Feralas's humid wilds. They defend their cave network fiercely and keep bone trophies. Intruders are driven from their hunting grounds.

sections.title: Curiosities in the Caves
sections.body: Gnomish distress signals have sometimes led into the deeper caves of Feral Scar Vale. Lost devices have become trapped there among the yetis, including robotic survey chickens. They wait to be activated and recovered.

faq.q: What kind of creatures live in Feral Scar Vale?
aliases: what is in feral scar vale
faq.answer: Feral Scar yetis dominate the vale. These massive, territorial predators live in its rocky caves and patrol the surrounding forest.

faq.q: Where is Feral Scar Vale located?
aliases: how to find feral scar vale
faq.answer: Feral Scar Vale lies in western Feralas, within the High Wilderness and south of the main road through the rainforest canopy.

faq.q: Why are there yetis in a lush rainforest?
faq.answer: Though yetis are usually tied to snowy mountains, Kalimdor's ancient wilds also hold Feral Scar yetis. This distinct kind has thrived in dense forest valleys for generations.

faq.q: What is the mechanical chicken inside the cave?
faq.answer: Homing Robot OOX-22/FE is a mechanical survey chicken made by gnome engineers. It crashed in a cave deep in the vale and became stranded behind the yeti lines.

angles.text: A stranded gnome homing robot lies in the yeti tunnels. As an engineer, you can use an emergency beacon to bring it safely back to civilization.
As a hunter, you can track Feral Scar yetis stalking the cliffs and test your skill at big-game hunting beneath the High Wilderness canopy.
